selection_rules: Select chapter vocabulary that is useful for advanced English reading preparation.
Prefer first relevant occurrence of each lexical identity in source order.
Include lexical items whose meaning, register, idiomaticity, or collocation behavior may slow a B2 reader.
exclusions: Exclude transparent proper names unless the usage is idiomatic or culturally important.
Exclude ordinary high-frequency words used in their most common sense.
Exclude duplicates already represented by the same normalized lemma, POS, and lexical type within the chapter.
proper_name_policy: Include proper names only when they carry lexical, cultural, or idiomatic learning value.
uncertainty_policy: If CEFR or sense is uncertain, keep the candidate only when context supports a useful reading card and mark uncertainty in enrichment.
